Commentary.Commentary: We are back. The players are out in the middle. Colin Ackermann to start with the ball.
...THE CHASE...

All to play for then in the second half, Zimbabwe will back themselves to chase this down despite there being turn on this wicket. Netherlands on the other hand, will have to bowl if they are to defend this. Join us for the chase in a bit.

For Zimbabwe, it is the spinners who did the trick. The likes of Sikandar Raza, Sean Williams and Wesley Madhevere were really good. Blessing Muzarabani bowled just the 6 overs but he impressed in those 6. Overall, Zimbabwe will be very pleased with how they bowled but not pleased with how they fielded. Had they been better on the field, Netherlands might have not got to the 200-run mark too. Still though, they will feel they are in a good position in this game.

That is a really good bowling performance from Zimbabwe! You can see they walk off the field with happy faces and rightly so. 232 is a score they will back themselves to chase. Also, after the start Netherlands got off too, the hosts pulled things back really well. After electing to bat, Max O'Dowd and Vikramjit Singh got their side off to a really good start. The two added over 50 but both fell in quick succession. Then there were a couple of other stands and a few batters got off to starts but none went onto make it into a significant score. They needed someone to go on and score big but that was not the case. The visitors kept losing wickets at regulat intervals and that meant they are under par at the moment.
A single to end then! That is a very good last over by Richard Ngarava! Bowls a wide yorker, it is jammed out towards point for one. Netherlands END WTH 231!

This is fuller and on off, Max O'Dowd looks to drive but does so uppishly and it goes straight to Richard Ngarava who takes it at mid off. A half hearted shot there by Max O'Dowd. TOSS - Netherlands have won the toss and OPTED TO BAT!

It is time for the decider, it is one win so far both the sides and it all comes down to this one. Everything to play for, the winner takes the series. We have had two brilliant games so far. The visitors won one after being down and out whereas, the hosts came from behind in the second to level the series. Who will now win the third? Let us hope we have another cracker of a game.
... MATCH DAY ...

It is now time for the third and final ODI match of this series between Zimbabwe and Netherlands. Well, the Dutch players travelled to Zimbabwe and against all the odds, took an early lead in this series. Although, they could not take an unassailable lead in the second match. Netherlands would feel that they were surely on their course to win the game and seal the series but a collapse costed them the game by a single run. This series now is level at 1-1, and both teams will be coming into the final encounter with an intent. Netherlands will need their middle-order to pull their socks up, they need to focus on capitalizing on the solid start by the top-order. Zimbabwe though, need their new ball bowlers to strike early and put the opposition under some early pressure with the blade. This match surely promises to be a cracker. Who will come out on top? We shall find out together.
